# Munnar.com

> > Munnar.com is the comprehensive travel guide and accommodation directory for Munnar, Kerala's premier hill station in the Western Ghats, featuring tea plantations, luxury resorts, and nature tourism.

This site serves as the definitive resource for planning trips to Munnar, offering detailed information about accommodations ranging from budget homestays to luxury plantation resorts, along with tour packages, attraction guides, and practical travel information. Located in the Idukki district of Kerala, Munnar is renowned for its tea estates, wildlife sanctuaries like Eravikulam National Park, and scenic beauty in the Western Ghats.

## Luxury Resorts & Premium Stays

- [Mountain Club Resort Munnar | Luxury Hilltop Cottages & Valley View Retreat](https://munnar.com/mountain-club-resort-munnar): Luxury hilltop resort in Chinnakanal with infinity pool, spa & cottages
- [Wolkenburg Resort & Spa Munnar: 4-Star Luxury Villas & Spa | Jacuzzi Stays near Anachal](https://munnar.com/wolkenburg-resort-and-spa-munnar): 4-star resort near Anachal with 32 rooms, Jacuzzi villas & spa facilities
- [Olive Brook Munnar – Luxury Plantation Cottages at Pothamedu](https://munnar.com/olive-brook): Luxury plantation cottages at Pothamedu with cardamom treks & dining
- [Pleasanthills Resort Munnar: Luxury Family Stay & Pool in Nature](https://munnar.com/pleasant-hill-resort-munnar): Luxury family resort with 18 rooms, pool & plantation walks in Western Ghats
- [Shamrock Resort Munnar | Best Viewpoint Stay in Pothamedu](https://munnar.com/shamrock-resort-munnar): Resort at Pothamedu Viewpoint with luxury villas & sunset mountain views
- [Trivers Resort Munnar | Luxury Valley View Stay in Chithirapuram](https://munnar.com/trivers-resort-munnar): 4-star resort in Chithirapuram with 36 rooms, attic suites & indoor pool
- [Seven Springs Plantation Resort Munnar | Luxury Nature & Plantation Stay](https://munnar.com/seven-spring-plantation): 20 villas at Letchmi Estate coffee plantation with trekking & bird watching
- [Diamond Homestays in Munnar | Luxury Premium Homestays Kerala](https://munnar.com/homestays/diamond): Directory of diamond-category luxury homestays with premium amenities

## Nature & Eco Resorts

- [Aranyaka Resort Munnar: Attukad Waterfall View Cottages](https://munnar.com/aranyakaresorts): Eco-friendly resort with Attukad Waterfall views at Pullivasal Estate
- [Falling Waters Munnar | Nature Resort in Kallar Vattiyar](https://munnar.com/falling-waters-resort-munnar): Riverside nature resort in Kallar Vattiyar with organic dining & forest treks
- [Ayursakthi Riverdale, Munnar – Riverside Eco-Resort](https://munnar.com/ayursakthi-riverdale-munnar): Riverside eco-resort near Pallivasal with Ayurveda & nature activities
- [JOY'S Resorts Munnar: Chinnakkanal Valley View Rooms & Tree House](https://munnar.com/joys-resort-munnar): Chinnakkanal resort with valley view suites, tree house & campfire
